etsy.title: Spoon Theory Poster, Today's Budget: 1 Choose Wisely, Funny Spoonie Wall Art, ADHD Gift for Adults
etsy.description:
A spoon theory poster for the day you wake up with exactly one spoon and have to choose wisely. A retro computer dialog box delivers the daily energy budget.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in and 8×10 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang in a home office, bedroom, or wherever the spoon count matters.

This listing is a physical poster print, not a substitute for professional medical or therapy advice. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Most spoon theory products on Etsy are digital downloads ($2-$10) or stickers; physical printed posters are a gap.
Common designs are infographic-style 'Self Care With Spoons' charts and affirmation prints like 'You are allowed to be out of spoons'.
Humor angle ('Used All My Spoons By 11am', 'Out of spoons, will use knives') appears mostly on stickers and tees, rarely as wall art.
Physical framed spoon theory prints run roughly $18-$22; canvas versions run higher.
Amazon spoon theory results are generic canvas prints from bulk sellers with boilerplate descriptions; no original or humorous designs.
Spoonie search on Amazon returns mostly tees, pins, and stickers, not posters; wall art is a gap.
Amazon neurodivergent posters lean clinical and educational (iceberg charts, definition prints); humor is underrepresented.

research.notes: Primary keyword 'spoon theory poster' is indexed on Etsy and directly describes this product. The sibling poster 'out-of-spoons' uses 'spoonie art' as primary keyword and focuses on the depleted/recharging angle; this poster's humor is about budgeting the one spoon you have.
